text.en:
Frozen Syrup-Soaked (Yaş) Kadayif

Tufan Organik Frozen Syrup-Soaked (Yaş) Kadayif belongs to the Kadayıf Varieties range. It is a natural food with roots in Gürün/Sivas; contact us for product, packaging and order details.

كنافة رطبة (ياش) مجمدة

Tiefgefrorenes sirupgetränktes Kadayif (Yaş Kadayıf)
